g.text: 1-roll board: no feeders, no second scale, no MCP23017. GPIO3 = BTT runout, GPIO20 = button, GPIO10 = buzzer.

g.desc: 1-roll board: no feeders, no second scale, no MCP23017. GPIO3 = BTT runout, GPIO20 = button, GPIO10 = buzzer.

g.text: U1 antenna at the board edge: no copper, parts or traces under it. USB is data only: plug in 12 V while flashing.

g.text: SB1 (U14, C37, J18) and SB2 (U15, C39, J19) are small boards on break-off tabs: their nets (SB1_*, SB2_*) reach the board only through the harness.
